scope: FileCore component performance and event delivery only; no application, controller, native UI or OS idle-wakeup profiling

environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.3.3 (swiftlang-6.3.3.1.3 clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx26.0

initial_evidence.build_first: Non-Sendable Any dictionary could not cross the detached task boundary; corrected by serializing to Data inside the worker. No product source changed.
initial_evidence.initial_run: Retained result-final.json used an upper-median summary and an immediate post-write observation window labelled idle. Subsequent driver computes the conventional median, measures untouched baseline separately, and retains full request-generation traces. No initial measurement was discarded or used as the minimum of retries.
